integrity.reasoning: The work preserves review-product-coherence's intended role exactly. The node is a whole-product coherence review: reasoned judgment across the five named axes (spatial memory, discoverability, input grammar, status clarity, real operator flow) with findings mapped to owning capability/milestone nodes, review-only with no implementation, running before audit-methodology-compliance. The delivered artifact does all of this: five axis verdicts with concrete file:line evidence (spot-verified against the source: open_verify test-only at app.rs:1092/3771+, keymap footer, exec.rs HubCmd table, fire.rs sole aa fire caller, runway half-body sizing), an Overall judgment, and a corrections-routed table mapping every finding to chart nodes 02-11 (per MAP.md) with severity, evidence, and correction proposals, including an explicit blocker (A5/B5 verify rooms unreachable → nodes 05+07). The subject diff contains only reviews/product-coherence.md — no source or implementation changes, satisfying the "review only" constraint. Ordering is preserved: the review renders judgment and does not perform the compliance audit (explicitly 'Prior artifacts consulted (not re-audited)'); audit-methodology-compliance remains pending and its dependency/constraint semantics are honored. Graph integrity is preserved: the review is grounded in the actual integrated state delivered by milestone-integration (and honestly flags that the verify/accept half of the milestone's e2e claim does not compose — precisely the roughness this node exists to surface), and it does not overclaim its dependency. Evidence citations check out against the repo; limitations (TUI not launched) are disclosed rather than hidden. Lane 1 owns criteria adjudication; from an integrity standpoint this change keeps the node's role and the graph's structure intact.
